Entry auction stops cheap fakes. Only 100 slots open each epoch. Bids decide the price.

Each bid locks for 3 epochs. Forgery burns the bid. Honest losers get refunds minus 2%.

At 60 per slot, 1,000 clones cost 60,000. Demand doubles, price doubles. The summit costs more than the base. A falcon sees the whole field. The basalt does not bend.
